description: This session’s address in the city (its custodial key’s), its name on the wire, and whether a table is open. export: true gives you the key pair itself to keep (save it as the SDK’s key file, or bring it back to a later session with use_key): what you buy, post, offer or bid on at the Bureau is read, accepted or delivered under this key after the session closes, so the Bureau takes those calls once the key is kept.

export.description: true: answer with the key pair { pub, priv, addr } to keep

name: whoami
